args.body: Take CSV-WORKED-EXAMPLE as one bounded acquisition experiment using existing evidence and executable inventory. The deliverable must help someone solve an observed problem immediately; do not rewrite generic sales copy, add checker features or repeat IndexNow submission. Preserve current live pages until a fresh exact digest passes host-enforced independent review. Existing commercial feedback has no classified requests and three unclassified sources; that does not establish zero demand or customers. Keep both live observation windows open and do not access private correspondence through EXEC.

description: Discovery remains the constraint. Create one source-backed worked CSV diagnostic example on the existing offer, preserving the live experiment and independent review. No funding or revenue is verified.
